# Navigation stop proximity logic (2026-01-18 14:55Z)

_**User**_

when the navigation is started there is a route between the two devices. In some cases those two devices will move closer to each other and the navigation should then stop automatically when they are close to each other (like a radius of 50m). When the user is closer than 50m anyway to the other device and starts the navigation this should not stop the navigation automatically

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_


Examining the navigation implementation to understand the current structure.

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

Please try again.\")\n                )\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func openInAppleMaps() {\n        // Open the route in the Apple Maps app using the selected transport type\n        guard let dest = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        let source: MKMapItem\n        let destination: MKMapItem\n        if isRouteReversed {\n            source = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\n            source.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n            destination = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n        } else {\n            source = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n            destination = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\n            destination.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n        }\n        var options: [String: Any] = [:]\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\n        case 0: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeWalking\n        case 3: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeTransit\n        default: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeDriving\n        }\n        MKMapItem.openMaps(with: [source, destination], launchOptions: options)\n    }\n\n    private func transportTypeFromSetting(_ value: Int) -&gt; MKDirectionsTransportType {\n        switch value {\n        case 0: return .walking\n        case 3: return .transit\n        default: return .automobile\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)",

        "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

        "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

## Summary

Implemented auto-stop navigation when devices are within 50m of each other.

### Changes Made:

1. **Added state variables:**
   - `autoStopDistanceThreshold`: 50 meters
   - `initialDistance`: tracks the distance when navigation starts

2. **Added helper functions:**
   - `recordInitialDistance()`: records the initial distance when navigation starts
   - `checkAutoStopCondition()`: checks if devices are within 50m and auto-stops if they weren't already close

3. **Integration points:**
   - Records initial distance in `onAppear` and after the first location fetch
   - Checks distance on location updates (user and device)
   - Checks distance in the auto-update timer cycle
   - Resets initial distance when switching devices

### Behavior:

- If devices start >50m apart and get within 50m → navigation stops automatically
- If devices start within 50m → navigation does not auto-stop
- Distance is checked whenever locations update

The implementation uses `CLLocation.distance(from:)` for accurate distance calculations and only auto-stops when the conditions are met.

        "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * PlaybackSpeedOverlay.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-05.\n */\n\nimport SwiftUI\n\n/// A centered overlay that briefly displays the current playback speed.\nstruct PlaybackSpeedOverlay: View {\n    let speed: Double\n\n    var body: some View {\n        VStack(spacing: 8) {\n            Image(systemName: speed &gt; 1.0 ? \"forward.fill\" : \"play.fill\")\n                .font(.system(size: 28, weight: .semibold))\n                .foregroundStyle(.primary)\n\n            Text(String(format: NSLocalizedString(\"playback_speed_format\", comment: \"Playback speed indicator format like 1x or 2x\"), speed))\n                .font(.system(size: 24, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))\n                .foregroundStyle(.primary)\n        }\n        .padding(.horizontal, 32)\n        .padding(.vertical, 24)\n        .background {\n            if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {\n                Color.clear\n                    .glassEffect(in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))\n            } else {\n                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20, style: .continuous)\n                    .fill(.ultraThinMaterial)\n                    .overlay(\n                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20, style: .continuous)\n                            .fill(Color.black.opacity(0.4))\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.25), radius: 16, x: 0, y: 8)\n    }\n}\n\n#Preview {\n    ZStack {\n        Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n            .ignoresSafeArea()\n\n        PlaybackSpeedOverlay(speed: 2.0)\n    }\n}",

properties for reactive updates\n\n### Dependency Injection\n- Use &#96;@EnvironmentObject&#96; for shared services\n- Pass dependencies through initializers when appropriate\n- Keep dependencies minimal and focused\n\n### State Management\n- Use local &#96;@State&#96; for view-specific state\n- Use &#96;@ObservedObject&#96; for shared state\n- Consider using &#96;@StateObject&#96; for complex state objects\n\n### Property Wrappers\n- Use &#96;@StateObject&#96; for objects that are created and owned by the view\n- Use &#96;@ObservedObject&#96; for objects passed in from parent views\n- Use &#96;@EnvironmentObject&#96; for objects injected through the environment\n- Use &#96;@State&#96; for simple value types owned by the view\n\n## Testing Guidelines\n\n### Unit Tests\n- Test business logic separately from UI\n- Mock dependencies for isolated testing\n- Use descriptive test names that explain the scenario\n\n### UI Tests\n- Test user workflows end-to-end\n- Use accessibility identifiers for reliable element selection\n- Test on different device sizes when possible\n\n## Common Patterns\n\n### Error Handling\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nprivate func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n    print(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n    errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### API Calls\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nTask { \n    await fetchAllLocations() \n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Animation\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nwithAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.5)) {\n    cameraPosition = .region(newRegion)\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n### Performance\n- Use &#96;LazyVStack&#96;         "contents": "/*\n * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com\n *\n * Haptics.swift\n * miataru\n *\n * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.\n */\n\nimport Foundation\n\n#if canImport(UIKit)\nimport UIKit\n#elseif canImport(AppKit)\nimport AppKit\n#endif\n\npublic enum Haptic {\n\tpublic static func notifySuccess() {\n\t\tperformNotification(.success)\n\t}\n\n\tpublic static func notifyWarning() {\n\t\tperformNotification(.warning)\n\t}\n\n\tpublic static func notifyError() {\n\t\tperformNotification(.error)\n\t}\n\n\tprivate enum NotificationType {\n\t\tcase success\n\t\tcase warning\n\t\tcase error\n\t}\n\n\tprivate static func performNotification(_ type: NotificationType) {\n\t\t#if canImport(UIKit)\n\t\tDispatchQueue.main.async {\n\t\t\tlet generator = UINotificationFeedbackGenerator()\n\t\t\tgenerator.prepare()\n\t\t\tswitch type {\n\t\t\tcase .success:\n\t\t\t\tgenerator.notificationOccurred(.success)\n\t\t\tcase .warning:\n\t\t\t\tgenerator.notificationOccurred(.warning)\n\t\t\tcase .error:\n\t\t\t\tgenerator.notificationOccurred(.error)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t#elseif canImport(AppKit)\n\t\t// macOS provides limited, generic haptic feedback\n\t\tDispatchQueue.main.async {\n\t\t\tNSHapticFeedbackManager.defaultPerformer.perform(.generic, performanceTime: .now)\n\t\t}\n\t\t#else\n\t\t// No-op on unsupported platforms\n\t\t#endif\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;SettingsManager&#96; stores all preferences in &#96;UserDefaults&#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.\n- &#96;iPhone_SettingsView&#96; binds directly to these properties and navigates to &#96;iPhone_LocationStatusView&#96; (now a page) or re-runs the onboarding flow via &#96;AppState&#96;.\n- Defaults are registered from &#96;Settings.bundle&#96;, enabling control from the system Settings app. The manager observes low‑power state and scene phase for UI effect gating.\n- Reverse geocoding threshold is user‑configurable (off/100 m/1 km/10 km; default 1 km) and applied centrally.\n\n## Location Status &amp; Error Handling\n**For users:**\n- A dedicated status view shows permission state, last GPS and server updates, background activity, and a log of recent events.\n- If a network or permission error occurs, an overlay explains the problem.\n- Map screens additionally display a network-error icon when the server cannot be reached.\n\n- The status view lists speed and battery (when available) and tracks route‑request statistics over the last 24 hours.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; posts &#96;didSendOwnLocationUpdate&#96; notifications; &#96;ErrorOverlayManager&#96; and &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96; provide reusable alert UIs, and map views toggle a network icon via &#96;showNetworkErrorIcon&#96; flags.\n- Status is presented as a dedicated page; related counters (e.g., daily route requests) are maintained in settings/state for diagnostics.\n\n## Caching and Reverse Geocoding\n**For users:**\n- Device list rows display last seen time, distance, and approximate place name without requiring a network connection every time.\n- Cached data is also used by device and group maps so known positions remain visible offline until refreshed.\n\n**For developers:**\n- &#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&#96; caches coordinates, manages a centralized reverse‑geocoding queue with a configurable distance threshold, and stores results in &#96;Application Support&#96;. Views consult the cache first before hitting the network and throttle UI updates to the configured map update interval.\n- Own‑device updates trigger immediate cache writes to kick off reverse geocoding promptly. A &#96;RouteCacheStore&#96; caches routes by device and transport, with distance‑based invalidation.",

        "contents": "# miataru iOS App - Project Overview\n\n## 🎯 Project Purpose\nmiataru is a privacy-focused iOS application that enables users to track their device location, share it securely with trusted parties, and manage multiple devices and groups. The app prioritizes user privacy, battery efficiency, and cross-platform compatibility.\n\n## 🏗️ Architecture Overview\n\n### Technology Stack\n- **Frontend**: SwiftUI (iOS 18.0+)\n- **State Management**: ObservableObject pattern with @Published properties\n- **Data Persistence**: UserDefaults via SettingsManager; Application Support files for devices/groups\n- **Location Services**: CoreLocation framework (foreground and significant-change background)\n- **QR Code**: CodeScanner (scan), QRCode (generate)\n- **Platforms**: iPhone and iPad\n\n### Core Components\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nmiataruApp.swift (Entry Point)\n├── MiataruRootView (Main Navigation)\n├── OnboardingContainerView (User Setup)\n├── LocationManagers/\n│   └── LocationManager.swift\n├── SettingsManagers/\n│   └── App Settings/ (SettingsManager, thisDeviceIDManager, Settings.bundle)\n│   └── Devices/ (KnownDevice, KnownDeviceStore)\n│   └── Groups/ (DeviceGroup, DeviceGroupStore)\n├── views/\n│   ├── Common/ (Shared UI)\n│   ├── iPhone/ (iPhone-specific)\n│   ├── iPad/ (iPad-specific)\n│   └── Mac/ (onboarding previews only)\n└── Assets/ (Resources &amp; Localization)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Common Components Overview\n\n- Shared UI (&#96;views/Common/&#96;):\n  - &#96;ErrorOverlay&#96;, &#96;ViewModifiers&#96; (adaptive toolbars/navigation)\n  - Device &amp; group UI: &#96;DeviceRowView&#96;, &#96;GroupRowView&#96;, &#96;DeviceNameLabel&#96;, &#96;DeviceBatterySymbol&#96;\n  - Map UI &amp; helpers (&#96;views/Common/Map/&#96;): &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96;, &#96;PulsingAccuracyCircle&#96;, &#96;MapScaleBar&#96; (+ &#96;MapScaleBarViewModel&#96;), &#96;MapCompass&#96;, &#96;OffScreenDeviceArrow&#96;, &#96;OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper&#96;, &#96;RouteGhostCalculator&#96;, &#96;RouteStyle&#96;, &#96;Shimmer&#96;\n- Data &amp; Caching:\n  - &#96;KnownDeviceStore&#96;, &#96;DeviceGroupStore&#96; (secure archiving under Application Support)",

        "contents": "        return false\n    }\n}\n\nstruct DeviceLocationMapWidgetEntryView: View {\n    let entry: DeviceMapEntry\n    @Environment(\\.colorScheme) private var colorScheme\n    @Environment(\\.widgetFamily) private var family\n\n    var body: some View {\n        ZStack {\n            if let device = entry.device {\n                GeometryReader { geo in\n                    ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {\n                        snapshotLayer(for: device)\n                            .frame(width: geo.size.width, height: geo.size.height)\n                            .clipped()\n                        if family != .accessoryRectangular {\n                            topFadeOverlay\n                            overlay(for: device, family: family)\n                                .padding(.top, overlayTopPadding)\n                                .frame(maxWidth: geo.size.width * overlayWidthFactor, alignment: .topLeading)\n                                .padding(.horizontal, overlayHorizontalPadding)\n                        }\n                    }\n                    .ignoresSafeArea() // fill widget content area\n                }\n                .widgetURL(URL(string: \"miataru://\\(device.id)\"))\n            } else {\n                Color.gray.opacity(0.3)\n                    .overlay(\n                        Text(NSLocalizedString(\"widget_no_device_selected\", comment: \"Shown when no device is available for the widget\"))\n                            .font(.caption)\n                            .padding(8),\n                        alignment: .bottomLeading\n                    )\n            }\n        }\n        .containerBackground(for: .widget) {\n            ContainerRelativeShape()\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground))\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func snapshotLayer(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; some View {\n        let referenceTimestamp = min(device.timestamp, Date())",

        "contents": "    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData, family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; some View {\n        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)\n        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)\n        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)\n\n        let primaryComponents = [device.name, locality, distance].filter { !$0.isEmpty }\n        let primaryLine = primaryComponents.joined(separator: \" • \")\n        let (primaryFont, secondaryFont, spacing, padding) = overlayMetrics(for: family)\n\n        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {\n            Text(primaryLine)\n                .font(primaryFont)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n                .shadow(radius: 2)\n            Text(lastUpdate)\n                .font(secondaryFont)\n                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)\n                .lineLimit(1)\n                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)\n        }\n        .foregroundColor(.primary)\n        .padding(.vertical, padding)\n        .padding(.horizontal, padding + 2)\n        .background(\n            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)\n                .fill(Color(.systemBackground).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))\n        )\n    }\n\n    private func overlayMetrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -&gt; (Font, Font, CGFloat, CGFloat) {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption2, 2, 7)\n        case .systemLarge:\n            return (.headline, .subheadline, 3, 12)\n        default:\n            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption, 2, 8)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private var overlayWidthFactor: CGFloat {\n        switch family {\n        case .systemMedium: return 0.9\n        case .systemLarge: return 0.92\n        default: return 0.9\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -&gt; String {\n        let locality = device.locality ??
